title: GEMSDOE2 — GEMS Fault-Mapping & Submission Workspace
description: DOE GEMS Prize geologic-fault mapping and submission workspace. Its Pages root redirects into a docs/ site with an executive summary, submission guide, source catalogue, methodology and measured-results pages. The landing page offers a direct fusion GeoTIFF/ZIP download, combining a fault backbone, multiscale geophysics and an ensemble, and a separate in-browser GeoTIFF builder backed by a different, earlier ensemble field; those downloads are not the same candidate. Committed validation reports check the template footprint, georeferencing and file format, but local/proxy metrics do not establish a hidden-label leaderboard score or a successful competition upload. The upstream pytest run recorded at this head fails the committed-pages reproduction test despite a successful Pages build (documented in the irregularities register).
